auditNote: Count verified at 2026-11-09 against the plugin checkout /Users/changfenhuang/projects/dsh-genui at git c2624ce (package.json 0.16.0): the renderer's own COMPONENT_SCHEMAS / GENUI_NATIVE_TYPES map (src/client/genui-runtime/schema.ts, re-exported by src/client/spec.ts) contains exactly 60 keys. The published npm package 0.15.0 (2026-10-28) contains 51 of them; the nine additions in the repo since that release are: choices, compare, date-picker, editor, entity-card, file-tree, image-group, popover, segmented-control. SKILL.md's summary vocabulary lists 58 types (it omits choices and map although both are documented in the file), so SKILL.md alone must not be used as the count source. Groups below are the site's five atlas filter ids (layout/display/chart/interactive/advanced), which follow SKILL.md's '组件词汇' sections; the template center's seven scenario categories (dashboard/data/flow/chart/interactive/quiz/advanced) are a different axis and do not apply to node types.
